source.title: String Quartet No. 2, Op. 17 — II. Allegro molto capriccioso
source.edition: OpenScore String Quartets; transcribed from IMSLP #18943

bars.description: Movement II only: bars 1–577 once in written order. No repeat signs occur in the selected MusicXML; thematic returns are written out.

endpoints.basis: The fresh pitch-energy overlay and source-pitch flux show the initial F4 attack near 1.36 s, before the louder repetitions at 2.24–2.82 s. The closing D2/D3/D4 onset lies near 443.8 s; the later 444.3 s energy rise belongs to that already sounding chord and is excluded. These measured windows are not an aural review.

provenance: Select zero-based half-open MusicXML measure indices [179, 756] from every part, preserving inherited clefs, keys and time signatures. Original CC0 MXL download remains unchanged.
Four source-defined instrument parts are retained, including all explicitly encoded subsidiary voices within each staff. MIDI articulations are not used to invent performed note lengths.
Metric-equivalence instructions and textual dynamics require semantics-preserving conversion to text for LilyPond 2.24.4; no note or rhythmic content is removed.
